description: RadarPulse Dynamics is creating SARVantage: an interactive remote sensing platform transforming NISAR and Sentinel-1 radar backscatter into intuitive cloud-free environmental diagnostics and disaster alerts. We track real-time floods, ground subsidence, and deforestation. Seeking team members skilled in SAR/InSAR data, Google Earth Engine, Deck.gl, and science storytelling. Let's make radar data accessible!
